originalGroup.material:
Garden Bench Note Story 025

A new bench appeared beside our block’s garden. Someone attached a note saying, "Please leave this space clear on Tuesdays." I thought the bench was reserved for one person every week. Later, I saw a delivery worker push a trolley through the gap next to it. The note was about the path, not the seat. The garden team moved the note to a small post beside the gap and added the words "Delivery access." People could still sit on the bench while keeping their bags out of the route. I was glad the new sign explained the purpose instead of making us guess.
